ui_bugs.issue: F01: Object.entries throws 'Cannot convert undefined or null to object' when localStorage contains null value
ui_bugs.location: useAttempt.js line 62: Object.entries(stored) throws if stored is null
ui_bugs.observed_behavior: Player loads but error message displayed to user
ui_bugs.root_cause: Try-catch on line 60 catches JSON.parse errors but not Object.entries errors on line 62

ui_bugs.issue: F02 & F07: Logout removes all tejas-draft-* localStorage keys WITHOUT user confirmation
ui_bugs.observed_behavior: All draft keys removed immediately on logout, no modal warning shown
ui_bugs.test_setup: Seed localStorage with synthetic draft keys, click [data-testid='logout'], verify keys removed
ui_bugs.user_impact: Users lose unsaved local drafts without warning when logging out

design_issues.issue: F03: MCQ options display raw text instead of rendered KaTeX math
design_issues.observed_behavior: Question stem uses <MathText> component with KaTeX rendering, but options use plain {value} text. If option contains '$\frac{1}{2}$', it displays as raw TeX string, not rendered fraction.
design_issues.code_audit: QuestionContent.js MathText component (lines 5-30) only used for stem (line 77), not for options. Player.js lines 309-330 show options with raw value. Results.js lines 413-420 also use raw text for options.
design_issues.test_setup: Navigate to Player or Results, check MCQ options with render_mode !== 'source'
design_issues.notes: Current test set uses render_mode='source' for all questions, so options show 'Option X (as shown above)'. Issue would manifest with typed options containing math notation.

behavioral_observations.observation: Malformed JSON and array data handled gracefully by try-catch on line 60. Only null value causes error due to Object.entries on line 62.
test_cases: Array instead of object: Handled gracefully

behavioral_observations.observation: Timer is server-based using anchor.current = {server, mono}. Reload fetches fresh server_now, timer not extended by reload.

Keyboard navigation works (Tab key), mobile viewport (390x844) has no horizontal scroll, body width matches viewport
